recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中幾乎全為大小一致的中小型芽細胞，核圓或略有凹陷、細胞質極少，正常造血細胞罕見，呈單調的淋巴芽細胞浸潤；T 或 B 系須以流式鑑定。
features: Monotonous population of small-to-medium blasts replacing marrow elements
Very high N:C ratio with scant rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented nuclei with occasional clefts
Fine to slightly condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this magnification
Scattered fat spaces and particle fragments; normal maturing myeloid and erythroid cells rare
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate magnification shows cellular particles and trails composed almost entirely of a monotonous population of small-to-medium blasts. The cells have very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to indented nuclei, relatively fine chromatin, and scant agranular cytoplasm. Maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors are markedly reduced. The morphology is that of lymphoblastic leukemia; flow cytometric demonstration of cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT is required for T-lineage assignment. Findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Cannot be separated morphologically; flow cytometry shows B-lineage markers (CD19, CD79a, CD22) without cytoplasmic CD3.
CLL cells have coarse, clumped 'soccer-ball' chromatin and mature CD5+/CD23+ phenotype without TdT or CD34.
Hematogones are a minor population with a spectrum of maturation by flow rather than a sheet-like, monotonous replacement of the marrow.
